title: THE MAP KEEPS THE CLOSING TIME DURING AN EXTRACT
why: His note of 2026-10-08: on the map, when an extraction is called or in progress, you still need to see how long that extraction stays open in raid time, to plan the route. The map swapped the closing countdown for the call or the hold, so it vanished just when it mattered. It now stays on, on its own row under the ring, in the same words every other ring uses.
now: On the map, a called extraction and one in progress still show when they close.
